frontmatter.name: glance-appwidget-updates-and-memory
frontmatter.description: Manages Android AppWidget state updates, background syncs, and RemoteViews bitmap memory limits with Jetpack Glance (androidx.glance:glance-appwidget) and AppWidgetProvider receivers on Android 17 (API 37). Use this skill when configuring Android 17 (API level 37) compileSdk/targetSdk and AndroidManifest.xml widget receivers, refreshing frozen or stale Glance widget UI after CoroutineWorker DataStore preference updates (updateAppWidgetState), downsampling images within the WindowMetrics memory limit for Siz

nodes.label: Step 1: Configure SDK levels, dependencies, and manifest declarations
Step 2: Estimate the widget memory cap and downsample images
Step 3: Deduplicate multi-size bitmaps and handle composition errors
Step 4: Pre-decode LazyColumn collection images and assign stable itemIds
Step 5: Push state updates, configure ActionCallbacks, and use WorkManager
